headline: Governor: Credit cannot and should not be the only source of capital for all development needs
summary: State Bank of Vietnam Governor Pham Duc An said credit cannot and should not be the only source of capital for development needs. He spoke at a conference on unlocking financial resources for the 2026-2030 period in the capital.
why: The State Bank of Vietnam sets monetary policy and oversees the banking system, so its views signal how credit and capital markets may develop.
